title: Aap Ki Zehra pe kaise zamane aaye
body:
Aap ki Zehra s.a pay yh kaisy Zamany aye..
Dekhiye log mery Ghar ko Jalany aye...
01. Jany soye thy Madinay kay muslaman kahan.
jalta dar dekh k fizza s.a yahe krte the fughan
Aag Derwazay ki koi to bujhany aye....
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Pasliyan toot gain mujh pay gira darwaza, or Chalta howa darwazay pay zalim Guzra, Zakham pehlu pay mery kitnay na janay aye..
<<DIVIDER>>
03. Taziyana mery Bazu pay laga jab baba, aa gai yaad madinay main mujhy karbobala, yad Abbas s.a k kattay howy shanny aye.
<<DIVIDER>>
04.Ghamzada mery gharany ko dilasa dynay, koi mohsin s.a ka mujhy aya na pursa dynay, log aye bhe tu bus dil ko dukhany aye...
<<DIVIDER>>
05. Jab sy Bandhi gai Haider s.a k galay mea rassi, dekh kr zainab o kulsoom ko kehtay hain yehi, kash tum ko koi qaidi na bannay aye..
<<DIVIDER>>
06.Ashk is baat pay Ankhoun sy Bahye jaty hain, dekh ayi hoon main dabar kisay kehty hain, Yad zainab s.a ke aseeri kay zamany aye..
<<DIVIDER>>
07. Baap ke qabr pay akber wo yay keh kr roye, meri Ghurbat kay mera Bhai nahi hai koi, kon hai sath jo zehra s.a ka nibhany aye.
